scope: Planning arithmetic based on existing X7 resource measurements; no new benchmark.
new_system_ids: not assigned/frozen until X8 GO protocol

limitations: Extrapolation, not measured X8 runtime or a certified hard bound.
Existing one-effective-core billing at 1 CPU/2 GiB is the basis; confirm current billing and RSS before any production plan.
New rank/spectrum paths and all 48 ranks can alter solver timing; resource pilot needs the largest workload and relevant spectra.
No queue-wait forecast. Formal requested running time excludes pilot, report and queue.
No new job is authorized until X8 GO and stage gates; cap is only a proposal.
No result-driven stopping, grid cuts, seed reduction, calibration, or retry is proposed.
